verdict.rationale: Sill streams either a single Mac window or the whole desktop. Its bar of window thumbnails ('Every window, one tap away') and an Apps list let the user switch to another window or launch an app mid-session. Nothing in the evidence shows choosing a specific monitor on a multi-display Mac. missing for 10: per-monitor selection on multi-display hosts, explicit documentation of switching between desktop and window views mid-session, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, I can view a specific monitor, window, or app on a multi-display host and switch between them mid-session

citations.quote: Sill shows a window from your Mac, or its whole desktop, on your iPhone or iPad
Sill's Apps list on an iPad held sideways, with a search field, the apps open now and every app installed on the Mac.
